answer: Each submission hangs on the dawn of a task receipt, and the quartz is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Reaching the spiral of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work.
